summary: Iteration-6 admin email-whitelist + role-system testing. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows: admin user sees Admin nav (with shield icon), navigates to /admin, can add a whitelist entry, see it in the table, remove it (with confirm dialog), and view Active Users table; non-admin client user does NOT see Admin nav item; direct GET /admin for non-admin shows 'Admin access required' toast (UI still renders shell but data load fails). Bootstrap & whitelist enforcement verified at code/DB level - exhaustive /api/auth/session live-test requires real Emergent X-Session-ID which is unobtainable in this env, but the 400/401 error branches and admin_exists check are verified.

minor.issue: Returns raw mongo docs without normalization. Legacy users created before is_admin field was added (e.g., pre-existing user 'gehi16@gmail.com') return without is_admin key. Frontend treats undefined as falsy so it displays as 'Client' which is consistent, but the response shape is inconsistent across users. Recommend hydrating via User Pydantic model so is_admin defaults to false explicitly.

The Mayank Gehi pre-existing user (sole real user) is now stuck as 'Client' because once any other admin exists (e.g., via fresh sign-in), the 'existing user + not admin_exists' branch will no longer fire for them. The whitelist requirement also blocks their sign-in unless their email is whitelisted by the bootstrap admin. Consider a one-time migration: promote the oldest existing user to admin if no admin exists, OR auto-whitelist all pre-existing emails on first admin bootstrap.

integration_issues.issue: Admin page UI still renders (form, empty tables) even after API returns 403; only a toast appears. Should redirect away or replace content with an 'Access Denied' card to avoid confusing UX.

action_items: Consider redirecting non-admin users away from /admin route at the React Router level (e.g., Route guard checking user.is_admin) instead of relying only on API 403 + toast.

Add migration / bootstrap fallback so pre-existing users (created before the admin system) aren't permanently locked out: either auto-promote the oldest user when admin_exists==False, or auto-whitelist all pre-existing emails when first admin is created.
Hydrate /api/admin/users response through User pydantic model (or $set default) so is_admin is always present in JSON.
critical_code_review_comments: Bootstrap logic in POST /api/auth/session correctly handles both branches (new user + existing user-without-admin) via 'admin_exists' lookup. Race condition possible if two new users arrive concurrently with admin_exists=False - both could become admin. Acceptable for low-volume admin bootstrap, but could use a unique index on is_admin=true or a transactional check.
Whitelist check uses lowercased email - good. Add unique index on allowed_emails.email to prevent duplicate inserts at DB level (current dup check is application-level only and racy).

DELETE /api/admin/users does NOT remove user's shipments/pickups/settings - only user + sessions. Per the message 'Remove their email from the whitelist to prevent re-signup' this is intentional, but orphan data accumulates. Document or add cascade cleanup option.
get_admin_user dependency is clean and reuses get_current_user - good DI pattern.
AllowedEmail.created_at is stored as isoformat string but model declares datetime; same pattern used as other models -- list endpoint correctly parses back. Consistent.

AuthCallback.jsx handles 403 from /api/auth/session and renders dedicated access-denied UI with data-testid='access-denied-page' and 'access-denied-message' - good. Tested only by code review (live trigger requires real Emergent flow).

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 pytest: auth-me admin flag x2, session 400/401 x2, admin-auth gating x6, whitelist CRUD x1 with 5 assertions, list-users x1, revoke rules x4, bootstrap state x2)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on testable flows (admin nav visible for admin, hidden for client; admin page renders; add+remove whitelist with confirm dialog; users table renders; non-admin direct nav gets 'Admin access required' toast)

test_credentials: Mongosh-created test sessions (TEST_ADMIN_ and TEST_FE_ prefixes). Real Emergent session_id unobtainable in test env, so 403 access-denied UI verified only by code review of AuthCallback.jsx.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed TEST_ADMIN_ / TEST_FE_; cleanup automatic via pytest fixture + post-test mongosh teardown. No TEST_ data remains in DB.
verified_endpoints: GET /api/auth/me returns is_admin: true for admin user
GET /api/auth/me returns is_admin: false for client user
POST /api/auth/session: 400 without X-Session-ID, 401 with invalid session_id
POST /api/admin/allowed-emails: validates email format (400 for 'not-an-email'), rejects duplicates (400), persists to DB, returns 200 with entry
GET /api/admin/allowed-emails: returns sorted-desc list with email/note/created_at fields
DELETE /api/admin/allowed-emails/{id}: 200 on success, 404 on non-existent id
GET /api/admin/users: returns user list with shipment_count integer per user
DELETE /api/admin/users/{client}: 200, deletes user doc + all sessions, downstream /api/auth/me with old token returns 401
verified_frontend_flows: Admin user: app loads, Admin nav with shield icon present (data-testid=nav-admin)
Click Admin nav -> /admin -> admin-page testid rendered, title 'Admin Panel'
Add whitelist entry: filled new-email-input + new-note-input, clicked add-email-btn, toast 'added to whitelist' appeared, whitelist-row-<email> rendered
Remove whitelist entry: clicked remove-email-<email>, confirm dialog accepted, toast 'removed from whitelist', row disappears
Active Users section renders with table; admin row shows 'Protected' (no revoke button), client rows show Revoke button
Non-admin client user: Admin nav NOT in sidebar (Shield icon absent)
Non-admin direct GET /admin: page shell renders but toast 'Admin access required' shown and tables stay empty
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin tests in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_whitelist.py use direct mongo session insert with TEST_ADMIN_ prefix + auto cleanup. Bootstrap via /api/auth/session requires real Emergent X-Session-ID which is unobtainable in test env - we verify only the error branches (400/401) and code-path logic via DB state. AuthCallback 403 access-denied UI is code-reviewed but not live-tested. Recommend main agent manually verify: sign in with a non-whitelisted Google account -> /auth/callback -> access denied page; OR mock by intercepting fetch in dev console. Two minor issues flagged (legacy user without is_admin field & non-admin /admin route still renders shell) are non-blocking but worth fixing.
rca of the issue: N/A - all listed features work as designed. Two non-blocking improvements flagged in backend_issues.minor and frontend_issues.integration_issues.
